decisions.reason: OpenGL graphic drivers are not ported; a new Rust Vulkan 1.3 graphic driver that follows the Oblikovati renderer takes TKOpenGl's place behind the TKService/TKV3d interfaces (user decisions 2026-10-01 and 2026-10-07).
OCCT native file formats are not ported; only exchange formats (STEP, IGES, STL, OBJ, glTF, VRML, PLY, DE) are.
VTK integration; VTK renders through its own OpenGL pipeline. Not yet discussed with the user.
